operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case identifiers everywhere (College_ID, Name, Member_ID, Round_ID, Rank_in_Round); must double-quote with original spelling.
DDL uses backtick quoting for `college` in member's FK clause; sqlite_master text must be replayed verbatim.
All columns declared NOT NULL=0 (nullable) yet original null_rate=0.0 on every column — TS may emit NULLs that the original never has.
All PKs are INT but declared without NOT NULL; sqlite allows NULL in a non-INTEGER-PK column, so PK uniqueness filtering can still leave NULL PKs.
round has composite PK (Member_ID, Round_ID) — TS composite-PK member gets max_l0=30; PK-duplicate drop is on the tuple.
Self-contained FK chain college<-member<-round; no self-FK, no dangling FK, no non-unique parent (all parents are PKs).
Tiny tables (5/10/6 rows) — choose_table_sizes will massively over-generate relative to original; original_values sampling k=min(5,len) is fine.
Country has only 2 distinct values ('United States','Canada') — String fuzzer will contaminate these heavily.
College_Location samples look like school names ('McGill','Western Ontario') not cities — semantic mismatch between column name and values.
Name columns hold person names in member/college.Leader_Name but school names in college.Name — same declared TEXT, different semantics.
All storage classes match declared types (integer/text); no affinity contradictions.
Rank_in_Round distinct=4 over 6 rows — ties exist in original (ranks repeat), so ORDER/RANK queries rely on ties.
operator_ts_expectations: All INT columns -> Number fuzzer, scale=0, range [-1,1] full-range; ints perturbed by +-1/+-2 — will produce negative IDs and 0.
All TEXT columns -> String fuzzer, length range from element lengths, CHARSET a-zA-Z 0-9(); 50% contaminate suffix/prefix/drop.
College_ID/Member_ID/Round_ID as PKs: single-col PKs get max_l0=inf (fresh draws unbounded), composite round PK member gets 30.
FK member.College_ID and round.Member_ID drawn from parent's FINAL filtered column with replacement — duplicates expected, ties in FK values.
Number fuzzer on PKs will emit negative/zero IDs and collisions; sample_fresh_primary_keys drops dup PK tuples but not NULLs.
String fuzzer on Country will emit random strings and contaminated 'United States'/'Canada' variants — FN risk for WHERE Country='Canada'.
String fuzzer on college.Name / Leader_Name / Decoration_Theme will emit random charset strings — FN for name-equality predicates.
Number fuzzer on Rank_in_Round will emit negatives and large ints — FN for rank range/ordering predicates; ties preserved by replacement draws.
Literal pool from train SQL will seed real values (e.g. 'Canada', 'United States', theme names) into String elements, giving some plausible values.
Empty parent (if college filtered to 0 rows) -> NULL FKs in member; round.Member_ID NULLs possible if member empty.
NOT NULL not enforced in Python; rows violating sqlite constraints (none here since all nullable) would be skipped at insert — here nothing skipped.
Likely FP source: missing ties/duplicates in small tables (5/10/6 rows) vs TS over-generating; likely FN source: implausible random strings/negative IDs.
